mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.space_id, a.principal_type, a.principal_id, a.permission, a.principal_key, CASE a.principal_type WHEN 1 THEN (SELECT u.display_name FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id = a.principal_id) WHEN 2 THEN (SELECT r.name FROM sys_role r WHERE r.id = a.principal_id) WHEN 3 THEN (SELECT d.name FROM sys_dept d WHERE d.id = a.principal_id) END AS principal_name FROM kb_space_acl a WHERE a.space_id = #{spaceId} ORDER BY a.principal_type, a.principal_id, a.permission

SELECT DISTINCT u.id FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = u.dept_id WHERE u.enabled = true AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kb_space_acl a WHERE a.space_id = #{spaceId} AND a.principal_key IN #{k} AND ( (a.principal_type = 1 AND a.principal_id = u.id) OR (a.principal_type = 2 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.role_id = a.principal_id)) OR (a.principal_type = 3 AND d.path LIKE '%/' || a.principal_id || '/%') ) )
